name: Quarto Authoring Bundle
description: Meta-feature bundling Quarto CLI and common templates for document authoring and rendering (without LaTeX/PDF support).

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'command -v quarto >/dev/null 2>&1 && quarto --version || echo "quarto not found"'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify Quarto CLI is available for the Quarto bundle
